seed: Sequence > Add Media at Playhead... is the menu bar's way to put a second clip or a sound on the timeline, where File > Import Media only fills the Library. A video lands at the playhead on a picture track free there with nothing playing over it, or a new one on top when every track is busy, its own sound linked under it; past the end of everything it goes on the end of V1, the editing session's second clip step. A sound lands as Add Sound always put one. The file goes on the Library shelf too, and one Undo takes the whole landing back. At Next defaults, no flag set; the Open panel is answered by importPicks.

steps.note: An eight second screen recording on V1, its sound on Audio under it, the playhead two seconds in

THE FIRST TEST: Add Media at Playhead with b-roll picked. V1 is busy at the playhead, so the clip lands two seconds in on a new V2 over it, seen at once and covering nothing; its own sound came with it, linked on a new Audio 2 under the recording's
THE SECOND TEST: the Library, opened, has b-roll.mp4 on its shelf, as an import would have put it
THE THIRD TEST: one Command Z takes the clip, its sound and both new tracks back
THE FOURTH TEST, the editing session's second clip from the menu: the playhead at the end of the recording, Add Media at Playhead puts b-roll on the end of V1, its sound following on the Audio track
THE FIFTH TEST: the same row with a sound picked lays fourteen seconds of music at the start on a sound track of its own, as Add Sound did
